title: Legora launches integration ecosystem spanning the enterprise legal stack
summary: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal work, today announced the launch of its integration ecosystem: More than 30 integrations with the platforms that law firms and in-house legal teams rely on most.
body_markdown:
Legora, the agentic operating system for legal work, today announced the launch of its integration ecosystem: More than 30 integrations with the platforms that law firms and in-house legal teams rely on most. The ecosystem connects the[Legora Agent](https://legora.com/product/agent) to the systems where legal teams already keep their documents, enforce their ethical walls, run their deals and manage their contracts, so work can be completed from start to finish rather than one task at a time. The full ecosystem can be explored at[https://legora.com/product/integrations](https://legora.com/product/integrations) .


Applying AI to work held in those systems has too often meant downloading files from one platform and uploading them into another, outside the permissions that govern them, and stitching together multiple discrete tasks across platforms. Legora's integration ecosystem is built to close those gaps and help customers get more from the legal technology they have already invested in.


“Using AI to draft a document or review a set of contracts saves time, but it goes further when lawyers can take a piece of work from start to finish without breaking off to go and find files,” said Bryan Tsao, Chief Product Officer at Legora. “Every trip to another system eats into the time AI saves. Our customers have spent years building the knowledge and controls inside their systems, and the integration ecosystem puts all of it to work in Legora. It’s the foundation for AI that completes legal work end to end.”


**Connected across the legal stack**


The ecosystem spans nine categories:


-


**Document and content management:**[iManage](https://imanage.com/) ,[NetDocuments](https://www.netdocuments.com/) ,[Microsoft SharePoint](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/sharepoint/collaboration/) ,[Box](https://www.box.com/home) and[Google Drive](https://workspace.google.com/products/drive/) . Lawyers can browse, search and work with matter documents in Legora and save new versions back without downloading or re-uploading, while the original platform remains the system of record.


-


**Knowledge and enterprise search:**[DeepJudge](https://www.deepjudge.ai/) , along with Model Context Protocol (MCP) connections to[iManage](https://imanage.com/imanage-products/the-imanage-platform/ai/model-context-protocol/) and[NetDocuments](https://www.netdocuments.com/) . The Legora Agent surfaces relevant precedent and prior work from across an organization's institutional knowledge, so lawyers can describe what they need rather than hunt for it.


-


**Virtual data rooms:**[Datasite](https://www.datasite.com/en) ,[SS&C Intralinks](https://www.intralinks.com/) , and[DiliTrust](https://www.dilitrust.com/) . Deal teams can review anything from a single contract to an entire data room in Legora, extract insight at scale in Legora’s[Tabular Review](https://legora.com/product/tabular-review) or generate closing checklists in[Legora Lists](https://legora.com/product/lists) , with data-room permissions carried through automatically.


-


**eDiscovery:**[Everlaw](https://www.everlaw.com/) . Litigators can bring evidence surfaced in discovery directly into research and drafting, grounding their work product in the factual record.


-


**Ethical walls and information governance:**[Intapp Walls for AI](https://www.intapp.com/walls/) and[iManage Security Policy Manager](https://imanage.com/imanage-products/security-governance/security-policy-manager/) . The ethical walls and confidentiality restrictions a firm already enforces determine what content Legora can retrieve, including every step the Legora Agent takes.


-


**Time and billing:**[Intapp Time](https://www.intapp.com/time-tracking-ppc/) and[Laurel](https://www.laurel.ai/) . Work done in Legora can flow into time capture and billing, giving lawyers more accurate time entries with less administrative effort. Data also flows back into Legora, showing firms how much time lawyers spend in Legora, what they use it for, and the value the firm is realizing.


-


**Contract management and eSignature** :[Docusign](https://www.docusign.com/) ,[Ironclad](https://ironcladapp.com/) ,[Sirion](https://www.sirion.ai/) ,[Agiloft](https://www.agiloft.com/) ,[Conga](https://conga.com/platform/contract-lifecycle-management) , and[DiliTrust](https://www.dilitrust.com/) . In-house teams can bring executed contracts, templates and playbook positions from their contract repository into their work in Legora, then send finalized agreements for signature in one connected flow.


-


**Productivity and business applications** :[Microsoft Copilot](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot) ,[Microsoft Outlook](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/outlook/email-and-calendar-software-microsoft-outlook) ,[Microsoft Teams](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/group-chat-software) ,[Slack](https://slack.com/) ,[Gmail](https://workspace.google.com/gmail/) ,[Google Docs](https://workspace.google.com/products/docs/) ,[Google Calendar](https://workspace.google.com/products/calendar/) ,[Salesforce](https://www.salesforce.com/) and[LawVu](https://lawvu.com/) . Legora connects to the inbox, calendar, documents, team chat, CRM and matter management, so work can start wherever a request arrives and stay tied to the conversations around it.


-


**Document automation** :[Avvoka](https://avvoka.com/) and[Document Drafter](https://documentdrafter.com/) . Lawyers can generate first drafts of the documents they produce most often from their firm's approved templates and guided questionnaires, without leaving Legora or departing from the firm's drafting standards.


**Designed with partners to complete work end-to-end**


Legora built each integration around how legal work moves between systems, rather than as a one-size-fits-all connector for a single task. A lawyer can ask the Legora Agent to retrieve a counterparty's markup from email, compare it against precedent the lawyer is permitted to see under the firm's ethical walls, redline the draft and save the new version back to the DMS, with time automatically captured along the way. An in-house team can take a request from intake to signature the same way. With Skills, legal teams can also encode their own standards and processes so the Agent handles each step the way they would.


Some integrations bring partner content into Legora, some bring Legora into the partner's platform, and several work in both directions. In every case, the connected platform remains the system of record and the source of truth for permissions, and Legora is built to complement it, not duplicate it. For customers, that means Legora can be rolled out across the organization without a parallel permission model to administer.


"With Legora connected to iManage, SharePoint and Microsoft 365, our teams can move from finding documents to drafting and reviewing them without leaving the platform. That end-to-end workflow is where we see the real value, and we're looking forward to extending it into data rooms through integrations like Datasite and Intralinks," said Dan Hendy, Global Legal Transform & Operate Lead at EY.


**Availability**


Integrations have been rolling out to customers in phases, with additional capabilities added over time. The launch builds on the significant number of integration partnerships that Legora has announced since May, with more partners joining in the coming months. More information on the Legora integration ecosystem is found[here](https://legora.com/product/integrations) .


**About Legora**


Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 130,000 legal professionals at more than 2,000 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 80 markets.
